10.t: A. Game Price Settings You can set the game price multipliers with Toggles A thru D (SW1) on the Game PCB.
(1) Number of POPEYE per Game Set the number of POPEYE per game with Toggles | & J (SW2) on the Game PCB.

y with Toggles K & L (SW2) on the Game PCB.

(4) Attract Music It is a new feature to play the theme music “POPEYE” on the game Attract Mode. You can select “With music” or “Silent” with Toggle O (SW2) on the Game PCB.
